Calculate nondemographic entrants across production cycles

Source: R/core_model_nondemographic_herd.R
calc_nondemo_start_sizes.Rd

Distributes the total number of animals entering a nondemographic cohort over the production cycles occurring within the simulated period, based on the number of cycle starts occurring within the fixed 365-day horizon.

Usage

calc_nondemo_start_sizes(
  cohort_stock_nondemo_annual_entrants,
  total_nondemo_cycle_starts_to_distribute
)

Arguments

cohort_stock_nondemo_annual_entrants

Numeric. Total number of animals entering the nondemographic production pathway over the simulated period for the assessed cohort block (FN or MN) (heads / simulated period).

total_nondemo_cycle_starts_to_distribute

Integer. Total number of cycle starts within the fixed 365-day time horizon for the assessed nondemographic cohort (FN or MN) (cycle starts / simulated period).

Value

A named list with the following element:

cohort_stock_nondemo_start_cycle

Numeric. Number of animals starting each nondemographic production cycle for the assessed cohort block (FN or MN), calculated by distributing total annual entrants over the total number of cycle starts (heads / cycle).

Details

The annual entrant stock is evenly distributed across all defined production cycle starts. The number of animals entering each cycle is calculated as:

$$ cohort\_stock\_nondemo\_start\_cycle = \frac{cohort\_stock\_nondemo\_annual\_entrants} {total\_non\_demo\_cycle\_starts\_to\_distribute} $$

where:

  • cohort_stock_nondemo_start_cycle is the number of animals entering each cycle

  • cohort_stock_nondemo_annual_entrants is the total annual entrants

  • total_non_demo_cycle_starts_to_distribute is the number of cycle starts

No rounding or integer enforcement is applied:

This means fractional values may occur when cohort_stock_nondemo_annual_entrants is not perfectly divisible by total_non_demo_cycle_starts_to_distribute. Handling of integer constraints (if required) is delegated to downstream processes.

This function is part of the run_nondemographic_herd_module().

See also

run_nondemographic_herd_module()
